question: If the ratio of corresponding sides of two similar trianglessqrt{5} : sqrt{7} is then what is the ratio of the area of the two triangles?
solution:
Given:

The ratio of corresponding sides of two similar trianglessqrt{5} : sqrt{7}.

Concept used:

If two triangles are similar, then the ratio of the area of both triangles is proportional to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.
